lesson.grammar_point: past of the verb to be (was / were: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Good evening, this is the news from Paris. Yesterday was the first day of the Paris Motor Show. The halls were very crowded: there were thousands of visitors. The tickets were twenty euros. The weather was rainy, but the visitors were happy. The new electric cars were the stars of the day.

Hi, I'm Bruno. Last October, I was in Paris for the Motor Show. It was my first time in France. The show was amazing, but it was very crowded. On Sunday, I was very tired, so I was in a small cafe all afternoon. The food was delicious, but it wasn't cheap. Paris was expensive, but it was a great weekend.

extra_audio.text: Last October, Bruno was in Paris for the Motor Show. On Saturday, the weather was rainy, and the halls were very crowded. The new cars were amazing. On Sunday, he was very tired. He was in a small cafe all afternoon. The food was delicious, but it was expensive.

paras: Bruno is a mechanic from Belo Horizonte. Last October, he was in Paris for two days. It was his first time in France. He was there for the Paris Motor Show, a big car show with brands from all over the world.

On Saturday, the weather was rainy and cold. The halls of the show were very crowded, and the new electric cars were amazing. Bruno's English was simple, but the people at the booths were very nice. They were happy to talk about their cars.

On Sunday, Bruno was very tired. He was in a small cafe near the river all afternoon. The coffee and the croissants were delicious, but they were expensive. Was it a good trip? Yes, it was. It was the best weekend of the year.
